scope: Read-only merged native BERT context/quantization boundary and CI/integrated-driver review. No builds or root-worktree edits by this reviewer.

findings.description: The prior-client driver asserted 232 implemented exports while its exact added set contained only ten adapter names, making the historical 216+10 set inconsistent with 232.
findings.resolution: Parent added the four encoder/classifier names and both quantization exports. Read-only set comparison now proves historical216 plus sixteen additions equals the exact current232 implemented names, with four extensions and23 absent.

checks: All merged encoder implementation/test files retain their committed validated hashes. The inference facade differs from the encoder worktree only by the additive BLOOM loader module declaration.

Context runtime remains explicitly Decoder or Encoder. Borrowed model data and BERT weights stay owned through Arc; decoder-only sampler, memory, state and adapter operations require a decoder runtime. The quantization module has no ContextHandle or model-handle state dependency.

Quantization wire structs match the frozen public C field order/types, including u8 C booleans, pointer-aligned typed sentinel arrays, the metadata tagged union and size_t. Conversion copies typed options to owned Rust values and returns the existing bounded C error status through the same panic boundary.
Both independent encoder runtime reviews and the active-vector admission guard remain intact after the clean cherry-pick; no new arithmetic or ownership delta was introduced by integration.

CI explicitly downloads BGE, supplies LLAMA_TEST_BERT_MODEL, and invokes the exact ignored native encoder test under release on both CPU matrix hosts. The test checks the pinned model length/SHA-256. The existing inference/server pretrained step remains separate.

The integrated driver invokes the unchanged192-case primary replay and the separate nine-case vector replay for both debug and release libraries, using distinct fresh output directories and reading each report.json. The vector script accepts LIB and NEW_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY exactly as called.

The integrated driver runs both typed public quantization C replays against the same selected debug/release libraries. Its export inventory is232/4/23, and the corrected prior-client exact set matches the historical checkpoint plus all16 additions.

Prior-client newly generated log names and the perf.stderr.log consumer match. The unchanged adapter helper has no stale export-count assertion; its legacy raw .stdout/.stderr files remain external and require the existing evidence-packaging naming convention.

Windows/GNU paths, inherited PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE, per-host targets, and failure-propagating replay subprocesses are coherent. This static review does not assert the future merged whole-workspace execution has completed.
qualification: The parent owns coverage/status/release-control edits and final validation/publication. This receipt applies to the pinned file bytes only; the full-port release gates remain open.
inference_facade_delta: Only mod bloom_loader; added to the validated encoder facade.
